record.name: Pairwise-plausible but three-way-inconsistent interpretation
record.analytical_setup: Let p,w,e be binary interpretation choices for one claimed process/workflow/event context. R_PW={(0,0),(1,1)}, R_WE={(0,0),(1,1)}, R_PE={(0,1),(1,0)}. Each pair relation is non-empty and projects to both values on each endpoint; each pairwise test has a witness. Their natural join is empty: p=w and w=e force p=e, contrary to R_PE. Operational reading: separately tested legacy/new semantic bindings silently disagree on which event means the process result. These are plausible local hypotheses, not three simultaneously verified truths about one actual case.

locally_satisfied_properties_or_restrict.what_holds: One model-to-enactment contract can have locally satisfying examples.
The chosen model/engine examples can pass within one version binding.
A sampled event interpretation can be intelligible in its own declared local context.

record.joint_failure: A consumer claims that all three views describe the same realised work without a shared interpretation; local witnesses cannot be existentially joined.
record.emergence_adjudication: Reject as a new BWP property: EPM-030 already requires global compatibility before recomposition and EPM-084 forbids incompatible receiving claims. Three VIEW variables in the witness are not proof of three indispensable research LINEAGES. EWM-040 is a narrower protocol analogue, not a theorem about these particular mappings.
record.scope_caution: Local satisfaction stated here covers only the named predicate/scope. It does not assert that all full inherited compatibility and outcome criteria are simultaneously satisfied.
